'''''Mimusops''''' is a genus of plants in the family [[Sapotaceae]], described as a genus by [[Carl Linnaeus|Linnaeus]] in 1753.<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/358368#page/361/mode/1up Linnaeus, Carl von. 1753.  Species Plantarum 1: 349]</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40020099 Tropicos, Mimusops L.]</ref>

''Mimusops'' is native to tropical and subtropical regions of Asia, Africa, Australia, and various oceanic islands.<ref name=POWO/><ref>Govaerts, R., Frodin, D.G. & Pennington, D. (2001 publ. 2002). World Checklist and Bibliography of Sapotaceae: 1-364. The Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew.</ref><ref>Allaby, Michael. 1998. ''A Dictionary of Plant Sciences''. Oxford University Press, New York</ref>
